backgroundMissing: The pre-2012 background file was not loaded, so months before February 2012 may read low.
chanceMeaning: How often fire was seen here in this month in past years. It is a count of what happened, not a forecast, and it has not been scored against what followed.
countryTestHeading: How well this country was tested
countryTestLine: Typical error {nrmse}, bias {bias} per cent, and {coverage} per cent of months fall inside the stated range. {reading}
countryTestLink: How we know it is right
countryTestNone: This country had too little fire to score on its own.
countryTestWeak: That is a weak fit, so read this country’s figures as a rough guide.
dataLine: Data to {date}, from {sensors} hotspots, converted by this project with model {model}.
failed: The fire record for this place could not be read.
hotspotsNote: The hotspots file holds one row per detection. It covers at most 366 days, so it opens with {year}, and it stops at {rows} rows, saying so in the file when it is cut. A point is capped at 200 km; a country or a drawn area is read as the box around it, so the file covers the box, not the exact shape.
hotspotsPartial: This country reaches across the 180 degree line. The file covers the side its middle is on.
hotspotsSlow: Large areas take a while: the file is read from the public archive.
loading: Reading the fire record for this place.
lowConfidence: This area is smaller than one grid square, so the figures are for the whole square around it.
noMeasurement: No satellite measurement for this month, so there is nothing to compare.
rangeNote: The calendar, the table and the downloads cover this range only.
satelliteCountryOnly: Counts per satellite are held for whole countries only. Pick a country to see them.
selectMonthHint: Pick a month in the calendar to change the two cards below.
soFarCountry: Days 1 to {day} are in, so this is part of a month. Comparing a part month with whole months would read as a collapse in fire rather than as a month that has not finished. A comparison with the same days in past years needs a point or a drawn area, because the daily files hold grid squares and not countries.
soFarNoDays: The daily files hold no measurement for days 1 to {day} of this month yet, so there is nothing to compare them with.
